scope.experience: Transcription and automated summary of a recording
scope.task: Record a meeting-length discussion, inspect the transcript and summary, and use summary topics or timestamps to check the original audio.
scope.configuration: User-initiated recording or a supported uploaded recording; no automatic meeting joining, CRM writeback or follow-up sending. No subscription was tested.
scope.audience_perspective: A meeting participant, student or knowledge worker reviewing a conversation

conversational.rationale: The product processes a human conversation, but the assessed user interaction is a structured recording and review workflow rather than chatting with the AI.
conversational.uncertainty: Otter AI Chat and live-agent interactions would warrant a separate conversational score.

specialization.rationale: Transcription, summaries and meeting takeaways serve a specific conversation-documentation workflow across several professions.
specialization.uncertainty: A specialized sales/recruiting deployment is narrower than this core meeting workflow.

autonomy.rationale: Once recording begins, the system transcribes and generates summaries without the user specifying each extraction step; people decide how to act on them.
autonomy.uncertainty: CRM actions, joining meetings and sending follow-ups are excluded; automation is scoped to creating the record.

accessibility.rationale: Searchable text and summaries suit learners and meeting participants, while suitable audio, recording setup, supported language and plan features limit reach.
accessibility.uncertainty: No speech-recognition accuracy or assistive-technology tests were conducted; recording access and quotas vary.

explainability.rationale: Original audio, transcript, speakers and timestamp navigation give users a concrete basis for checking summaries.
explainability.uncertainty: Both transcript and summary may contain errors, and visible timestamps do not explain all summarization decisions.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no live product or transcription-quality tests. Scope: Otter recording/transcription and automated summary review, excluding AI Chat, CRM actions and autonomous follow-ups. Scores are design estimates. Sources: https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/5093383818263-Automated-Live-Summary-Overview and https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/360047733634-Export-conversations .
